title: Backup and restore app data to a JSON file
when: A browser app keeps data locally (localStorage or IndexedDB) and users need to back it up, move it to another device or recover it.
prompt:
Goal: A versioned backup file users can download and restore, validated before it replaces anything, with an automatic safety copy.
Steps:
1. Format { app: "notes", format: 1, exportedAt: ISO string, data: { ... } }, pretty printed with 2 spaces.
2. Download as notes-backup-2026-10-17.json through a Blob of type application/json and a temporary download link.
3. Restore: file.text(), JSON.parse in try, check app and format, migrate older formats, validate every collection.
4. Keep the current data as a safety copy before replacing, and offer Undo for the session.
5. Confirm with specifics ("Restore 54 notes from 12 Oct 2026, replacing 20 notes").
6. Nudge with a dismissible note when the last backup is older than 30 days.
Quality bar:
- Backups from older versions restore correctly.
- A wrong or broken file never deletes current data.
- File names sort by date.
Pitfalls:
- Restoring without validation.
- Secrets or other users data inside the file.
- Silent failures; report success or the exact problem.
Verify:
- [ ] File has app, format and exportedAt.
- [ ] JSON.parse in try.
- [ ] Confirmation before replacing.
- [ ] Safety copy kept.
Output: js/backup.js exporting exportBackup() and restoreBackup(file), with buttons in the settings view.

examples.input: quero passar minhas anotações do notebook para o celular
examples.output: Download backup (notes-backup-2026-10-17.json) and Restore with validation, confirmation and undo
